request: What can Tenant help me do?
reply:
Tenant can help you create things, use apps, and control connected room devices.

Try asking:
- “Build me a simple website.”
- “Create a presentation about my idea.”
- “Research this topic and compare the options.”
- “Help me write or debug some code.”
- “Show me which room devices are available.”
- “Start a beat at 90 BPM.”
- “Blink the connected light five times.”

Tell me what you want to do in plain language.
transport: Actual public HTTPS enrollment and WSS guest chat into fixed native room conversation
limits: Default text and absence of automatic room-device speech verified from actual native/transport receipts.
No human audibility claim and no physical opt-in/opt-out observation.
One-off say and voice consent/queue isolation pass automated tests; actual natural-language ongoing opt-in/opt-out is delegated to local E2E tester.
Discovery offer covers enrolled Tenant speaker connections, not OS/Bluetooth route changes.
